conditions.baseline: Working-tree core including the existing single-root deletion fix; benchmark app using cacheUpdate.
conditions.timing: Minified Vite build. Chromium 153.0.8010.12. 4x CPU throttle. No stylesheet. Includes click and queued microtask render, excludes subsequent paint.
conditions.samples: 6 warmups/page; 12 samples x 2 rounds; reversed variant order in second round. Timing table uses median across all 24 samples.
conditions.profile: Separate unminified build; 100us sampling interval; 12 operations; listed self times are average ms/op.
conditions.verification: Browser assertions on row counts, labels, selection, keyed DOM identity/order. Verification durations are not benchmark data.
conditions.limits: Diagnostic prototypes; no changes applied to runtime sources; no full regression suite or official runner remeasurement for candidates.
